description: Generic Johnson broad-band passbands (U, B, V, R, I, J, M) as held in the SVO Filter Profile Service 'Generic/Johnson' group.
short_description: Generic Johnson UBVRIJM passbands (SVO Generic/Johnson group)
facility_description: Generic photometric-system passbands, not tied to a single telescope or instrument.
notes: SVO gives no ProfileReference for this group in the archived VOTables, so the original source of these curves is not identified; Johnson & Morgan (1953) is the defining paper of the UBV system only, not a confirmed source of these tables. Description values are copied verbatim from SVO VOTables via Wayback captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es timed out all session). Licence unknown: SVO's own terms page could not be reached; the SVO acknowledgement already on NJM was not re-verified. No archived VOTable for: R, V. U, B, V, R, I, J, M (2026-11-12): each curve is Johnson (1965, ApJ 141, 923), Appendix, 'The Photometer Response Functions', Tables A1-A3, value for value. Johnson writes 'Except for the U filter, these response functions include no corrections for atmospheric extinction' and 'The R and I response functions include the reflectivity of two aluminized mirrors', and each response belongs to its detector (L I with an InSb detector, L II with a PbS cell). So U is filter+qe+atmosphere, R and I filter+optics+qe, and B, V, J and M filter+qe, ComponentsSource original, on every copy of these curves.
